title: Canucks vs Flames
blurb: Pacific Division rivalry night. Doors at 6, puck drops at 7, and the kitchen runs game-day specials all three periods.

title: BC Lions vs Winnipeg
blurb: West Division football on the waterfront patio. Heaters on, wings half price at halftime.

title: Real Madrid vs Barcelona
blurb: El Clásico. The single loudest room we book all season — arrive early, this one always goes.

title: Lakers vs Celtics
blurb: The oldest rivalry in basketball on a twelve-foot projector wall, with a cocktail list to match.

title: Seahawks vs 49ers
blurb: NFC West on tiered stadium seating with broadcast-grade sound. Jerseys get you a drink special.

title: Raptors vs Warriors
blurb: Canada's team in a proper neighbourhood room. Weekly prize draw at the end of the third.

title: Juventus vs Inter Milan
blurb: Derby d'Italia over a late breakfast. Espresso menu runs all morning.

title: Whitecaps vs LAFC
blurb: Local side, Western Conference stakes, and a patio that looks straight across False Creek.

title: Blue Jays vs Yankees
blurb: AL East baseball with a Toronto-heavy crowd. Peanuts on the house, obviously.

title: Arsenal vs Man City
blurb: Sunday morning football with a full breakfast menu and the sound turned up.
